# The Horse Planet

> > The Horse Planet is a comprehensive Italian equestrian e-commerce platform offering equipment, tack, and accessories for multiple riding disciplines including English, Western, Spanish, and harness racing.

The Horse Planet serves the European equestrian market with specialized product categories across different riding styles, horse care supplies, and rider apparel. The platform emphasizes free shipping on orders over €199 and maintains GDPR compliance for customer data protection.

## Key Topics

- Monta Inglese (English Riding)
- Monta Western (Western Riding)
- Monta Spagnola (Spanish/Vaquera Riding)
- Trotto (Harness Racing)
- Equestrian Equipment
- Horse Tack & Saddles
- Rider Clothing & Accessories
- Horse Supplements & Nutrition
- Stable & Paddock Equipment
- Selleria (Leather Goods)
- Horse Care Products
- Italian E-commerce
- Online Shop
- Outlet & Promotions
- Gift Cards

## Main Shop

- [The Horse Planet Homepage](https://www.thehorseplanet.com): The Horse Planet homepage: equestrian equipment shop for multiple riding styles
- [Horse Equipment & Supplies](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/cavallo): Horse equipment and supplies: saddles, tack, health products, nutrition
- [Rider Clothing & Accessories](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/cavaliere): Rider clothing and accessories: boots, helmets, gloves, breeches, leggins

## Riding Disciplines

- [English Riding (Monta Inglese)](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/monta-inglese): English riding equipment: saddles, tack, and accessories online shop
- [Western Riding (Monta Western)](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/monta-western): Western riding equipment: saddles, tack, boots, and traditional accessories
- [Spanish Riding (Monta Spagnola)](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/monta-spagnola): Spanish/Vaquera riding equipment and accessories online catalog
- [Harness Racing (Trotto)](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/trotto): Harness racing/Trotto equipment with free shipping from €199

## Horse Care & Nutrition

- [Horse Supplements & Nutrition](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/integratori-cavalli): Horse supplements and nutrition products with free shipping from €199
- [Stable & Paddock Equipment](https://www.thehorseplanet.com/scuderia-e-paddock): Stable and paddock equipment for horse care and management
